name: Afghanistan Calendar – Hijri Shamsi
author: abdulbasirmatin

sections.description:
Afghanistan Calendar – Hijri Shamsi is a professional WordPress plugin…

Features:

  • Afghanistan Hijri Shamsi calendar
  • Shortcode: [afghanistan_calendar]
  • Elementor widget with design controls
  • WordPress widget
  • Frontend date conversion
  • Dashboard date conversion
  • RTL website option
  • Date format settings
  • Persian digits option
  • Responsive and modern design
  • No external dependencies
  • Translation ready
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/afghanistan-calendar-hijri-shamsi/ or install the ZIP file from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Afghanistan Calendar.
  3. Go to Settings > Afghanistan Calendar.
  4. Use the shortcode [afghanistan_calendar], WordPress widget, or Elementor widget.
sections.faq:
Does it support Elementor?

Yes. It includes a dedicated Elementor widget named Afghanistan Calendar.

Does it change website dates?

Yes. You can enable or disable frontend and dashboard date conversion from settings.

Does it support RTL?

Yes. RTL can be enabled for the website frontend only.
